reviewNote: Drafted by Claude from the chart for faculty review. Not validated teaching content.
summary: Elective robotic hernia repair 5 weeks after a DES for NSTEMI, with both antiplatelets stopped by a surgery instruction sheet, new inferior Q waves, and nitroglycerin use for exertional chest tightness this week.

asa.rationale: MI within 3 months with ongoing angina and a fresh drug eluting stent off antiplatelet therapy.

decision.rationale: Cardiology discharge: do not interrupt DAPT and defer elective surgery at least 6 months. DAPT has been stopped for 6 to 8 days with new angina and new inferior Q waves: high stent thrombosis risk. Cancel, restart antiplatelets, and get cardiology evaluation today.

redFlags.finding: DAPT stopped 5 weeks after a drug eluting stent
redFlags.evidence: DES to RCA 09/20; aspirin stopped 10/19 and clopidogrel 10/21 per surgeon's standard sheet; cardiology said do not interrupt and defer elective surgery 6 months.
redFlags.action: Cancel elective surgery, resume aspirin and clopidogrel, contact cardiology.

redFlags.finding: Active ischemic symptoms and new ECG findings
redFlags.evidence: Chest tightness with stairs this week, nitroglycerin 10/24, not told to surgeon; 10/24 ECG new inferior Q waves and T inversion.
redFlags.action: Cardiology evaluation (troponin, ECG) before any surgery.

redFlags.implication: Cream is not a clear liquid; ASA guidance treats it like non-human milk (6 h).
redFlags.action: Not eligible for a 0730 start even if the case were otherwise appropriate.

redFlags.implication: Limited reserve for pneumoperitoneum and Trendelenburg.
redFlags.action: Arterial line and hemodynamic goals if surgery is later rescheduled.

redFlags.finding: No cardiology clearance requested; PCP deferred to cardiology
redFlags.evidence: Orders: cardiology clearance not requested; PCP letter defers.

planItems.item: Cancel and reschedule after 6 months on DAPT per cardiology
If ever done: arterial line, ischemia monitoring
Cefazolin 2 g within 60 min of incision
